errors.text: The proposed Si addition and silicide network are not supported by evidence for the Hf-Mo-Ta-Ti-Zr system; the cited studies concern materially different alloy chemistries and phase structures.

Describing HfSi2- or MoSi2-type silicides as a ductile network is scientifically questionable. A grain-boundary-connected silicide phase is likely to provide a brittle intergranular crack path rather than plasticity compensation.

The experiment compares only undoped and Si-doped states, so solute strengthening and secondary-phase effects remain confounded; a Si-containing single-phase control or morphology-varied samples at matched matrix composition are required.
